title: Where Should LLM Agents Adapt at Test Time? In Context, in Weights, or Both
abstract: arXiv:2611.19700v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. translated_title: 大语言模型智能体应该在测试时于何处进行适应？在上下文中、在权重中，还是两者兼有
translated_abstract: 在同一环境（如代码仓库、数据库或应用程序套件）中反复运行的大语言模型（LLM）智能体，会遇到共享潜在结构的任务。经验可以揭示这种结构，使智能体能够复用环境知识并从环境反馈中学习。智能体可以通过两个渠道在测试时利用这些经验进行适应：将经验保留在上下文中，或更新自身权重。这两个渠道通常被分开研究，导致人们不清楚各自的贡献是什么，以及何时能够互补。我们通过共享的在线协议和模块化框架，比较了上下文学习（ICL）、使用GRPO的基于可验证奖励的强化学习以及使用SDPO的自蒸馏，包括单独使用和组合使用。智能体遇到匹配的任务流，在适应每个任务之前先对其进行评估，并且仅从自身的尝试和环境反馈中学习。我们评估了14种适应机制以及一个……
tldr: 该论文通过统一的在线协议系统性地比较了上下文学习、强化学习和自蒸馏三种测试时适应机制及其组合，揭示了上下文和权重这两个适应渠道各自的作用及其互补条件。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares in-context learning, reinforcement learning with GRPO, and self-distillation with SDPO—alone and in combination—under a shared online protocol, revealing what each test-time adaptation channel contributes and when they complement each other for LLM agents.
